title: Meet & Greet
location: Caffe Van Gogh, Lämmlisbrunnenstrasse 45, 9000 St. Gallen
description: Our first casual get-together of the semester: come meet the board and other members over drinks, no agenda. Time to be announced soon; follow @yunited.unisg to be first to know.
